messages.subject: sessioninfo_part1 file not created
parts:
Hello,

I am hoping you can help me with an error I am getting when running part 1.  I am getting an error saying it cannot open 'sessioninfo_part1.RData', and I can verify that this file was not created. The program has generated many other files.  

Checking that user has read access permission for all files in data directory: Yes
Checking that user has write access permission for directory specified by argument outputdir: Yes

 Busy processing ... see C:/Users/.../output_csv/meta/basic for progress
Error in gzfile(file, "wb") : cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning message:
In gzfile(file, "wb") :
  cannot open compressed file '/results/QC/sessioninfo_part1.RData', probable reason 'No such file or directory'

thank you in advance for your assistance,

Joanne

messages.author: 13568954e9b4ef4b
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] sessioninfo_part1 file not created
parts:
Hello Joanne,

I am also getting more of these kind of messages in the last couple of months. I agree that they are not very informative, so an area for improvement.

The error relates to a bit of code at the very end of GGIR part 1, which may indicate that part 2 can still run. Can you try to run part 2, 3, 4, 5 of GGIR? (argument mode = 2:5)

Another approach could be to see whether you could reproduce the problem by re-processing your data in a new output folder.  My feeling is that GGIR is more likely to be confused when data is processed in different stages while some details of the R script or the location of folders changes in between those stages.

Best, Vincent
